transform.calculate: {'Train': 'Only Perth\'s trains are fully back', 'Bus': 'Buses in the smaller capitals lag most', 'Tram / light rail': 'New lines lifted Sydney and Canberra', 'Ferry': 'Every ferry service is near or above 2019'}[datum.mode]

transform.filter: (datum.mode == 'Bus' && indexof(['Perth','Brisbane'], datum.city) >= 0) || (datum.mode == 'Tram / light rail' && indexof(['Canberra','Sydney'], datum.city) >= 0)
